This directory contains C code generated by fiat-crypto
https://github.com/mit-plv/fiat-crypto (fiat-c/src/).

The p256, p384 and secp256k1 field and scalar files were copied from
commit e6946985c9165b3270eae457c0fae887cd7b7b76 without modification.
They back the portable implementations of src/ballet/secp256r1,
src/ballet/secp384r1 and src/ballet/secp256k1 (the *_ref.c files),
which are selected when FD_HAS_S2NBIGNUM is unset, e.g. on noarch
machines.

fiat-crypto code is synthesized from a verified specification: never
edit these files locally, re-copy them from upstream instead.

For licensing information see NOTICE in the root of this repo.
